title: Alien Maze Assault
description: A first-person shooter where you navigate a randomly generated 3D maze, eliminate alien enemies with raycast shooting, collect ammo drops, and survive to complete the mission.
prompt:
You are an expert game developer specializing in browser-based games.

Create a complete, playable first-person shooter (FPS) web game using only HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The game must run locally in a browser without requiring a backend server.

GAME CONCEPT
------------
Title: Alien Maze Assault

The player spawns inside a randomly generated maze and must eliminate all aliens to win.

GAME REQUIREMENTS
-----------------

TECHNICAL
- Use Three.js for 3D rendering.
- Deliver the game as a single self-contained project.
- Include all HTML, CSS, and JavaScript code.
- The game must be immediately runnable by opening index.html.
- Organize code clearly with comments.
- Prioritize performance and simplicity.
- Do not use placeholder code or pseudocode.
- Fully implement all systems.

PLAYER
------
- First-person controls.
- WASD movement.
- Mouse-look using Pointer Lock API.
- Left click fires weapon.
- Spacebar can optionally be used for jump.
- Player starts with limited ammo.
- Display health and ammo on screen.
- Player has 100 health.

MAZE
----
- Generate a random maze every time a new game starts.
- Maze should have walls, corridors, and dead ends.
- Ensure that every area is reachable.
- Place enemies in random valid maze locations.
- Maze size should be configurable.

WEAPON
------
- Single weapon only.
- Instant-hit raycast shooting.
- Visible muzzle flash.
- Shooting consumes ammo.
- Prevent shooting when ammo reaches zero.
- Display current ammo count.

ENEMIES
-------
- Alien enemies using simple 3D models or primitive geometry.
- Spawn a random number of enemies throughout the maze.
- Enemies patrol when player is not visible.
- Enemies detect player within a radius.
- Enemies chase player when detected.
- Enemies stop and shoot when in range.
- Enemy projectiles damage player.
- Enemies have health.
- Enemies die when health reaches zero.

AMMO DROPS
----------
- Every enemy must drop ammo when killed.
- Ammo is automatically collected when the player touches it.
- Ammo drop amount should be randomized within a reasonable range.
- Display floating pickup object.

GAMEPLAY
--------
- Player wins when every alien is eliminated.
- Display a victory screen.
- Player loses when health reaches zero.
- Display a game over screen.
- Allow restarting without refreshing the page.

UI
--
Display:
- Health
- Ammo
- Remaining enemies
- Crosshair
- Start screen
- Victory screen
- Game over screen

VISUALS
-------
- Sci-fi style.
- Basic lighting.
- Shadows if they do not significantly impact performance.
- Distinct enemy colors.
- Different visual effect for bullets/projectiles.
- Flash effect when taking damage.

OPTIONAL ENHANCEMENTS
---------------------
If reasonable, also implement:
- Footstep sounds.
- Shooting sound.
- Enemy sound effects.
- Simple minimap.
- Difficulty scaling based on enemy count.

OUTPUT FORMAT
-------------
Provide:
1. Project structure.
2. Complete source code for every file.
3. Instructions to run locally.
4. No explanations before the code.
5. No pseudocode.
6. No abbreviated sections.
7. Generate a fully functional game implementation.
